title: Photosynthesis
extract: Photosynthesis is a process used by plants and other organisms to convert light energy into chemical energy that can later be released to fuel the organism's activities.

title: Machine learning
extract: Machine learning is a field of study in artificial intelligence concerned with the development and study of statistical algorithms that can learn from data and generalise to unseen data.

title: Mitochondrion
extract: A mitochondrion is an organelle found in the cells of most eukaryotes. Mitochondria generate most of the cell's supply of adenosine triphosphate (ATP), used as a source of chemical energy.

title: Renaissance
extract: The Renaissance was a period in history and a cultural movement marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity, covering the 15th and 16th centuries.

title: Supply and demand
extract: In microeconomics, supply and demand is an economic model describing how the interaction of supply and demand in a market determines the quantity and price of a good.

title: Plate tectonics
extract: Plate tectonics is the scientific theory that Earth's lithosphere comprises a number of large tectonic plates which have been slowly moving since about 3.4 billion years ago.

title: Immune system
extract: The immune system is a network of biological processes that protects an organism from disease. It detects and responds to pathogens ranging from viruses to parasitic worms.

title: Quantum mechanics
extract: Quantum mechanics is a fundamental theory in physics that describes the behaviour of nature at and below the scale of atoms: the motion and interaction of subatomic particles.

title: Democracy
extract: Democracy is a form of government in which the people have the authority to deliberate and decide legislation, or to choose governing officials to do so.

title: Chocolate
extract: Chocolate is a food made from roasted and ground cacao seed kernels that is available as a liquid, solid, or paste, either alone or as a flavouring agent in other foods.

title: Solar System
extract: The Solar System is the gravitationally bound system of the Sun and the objects that orbit it. It formed about 4.6 billion years ago from the gravitational collapse of a giant interstellar molecular cloud.

title: World War II
extract: World War II was a global conflict that lasted from 1939 to 1945. It involved the vast majority of the world's countries forming two opposing military alliances: the Allies and the Axis.

title: Evolution
extract: Evolution is the change in the heritable characteristics of biological populations over successive generations. These characteristics are the expressions of genes.

title: Internet
extract: The Internet is the global system of interconnected computer networks that uses the Internet protocol suite to communicate between networks and devices.

title: Jazz
extract: Jazz is a music genre that originated in the African-American communities of New Orleans in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, with its roots in blues and ragtime.

title: Climate change
extract: Climate change refers to long-term shifts in temperatures and weather patterns. Since the 1800s human activities have been the main driver of climate change, primarily due to burning fossil fuels.

title: DNA
extract: Deoxyribonucleic acid is a polymer composed of two polynucleotide chains that coil around each other to form a double helix. It carries genetic instructions for development and function.

title: Olympic Games
extract: The modern Olympic Games are the world's preeminent international sporting events. They feature summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate.

title: Shakespeare
extract: William Shakespeare was an English playwright, poet and actor. He is widely regarded as the greatest writer in the English language and the world's pre-eminent dramatist.

title: Black hole
extract: A black hole is a region of spacetime where gravity is so strong that nothing, including light and other electromagnetic waves, has enough energy to escape it.
